title: Rotary Youth Exchange Talk
summary: A Rotary Youth Exchange (RYE) orientation session was organised by Rotary Club of Mumbai Mahim at Chatrapati Shivaji Vidyalaya, Dharavi, for Interactors and their parents.
description: A Rotary Youth Exchange (RYE) orientation session was organised by Rotary Club of Mumbai Mahim at Chatrapati Shivaji Vidyalaya, Dharavi, for Interactors and their parents. Rotarian Ashmi Parekh from Rotary District 3141 conducted the session and explained the RYE programme, its benefits and the experiences students can gain through international cultural exchange. She spoke about learning new languages and cultures, experiencing different food habits and lifestyles, meeting people from diverse backgrounds and building lifelong friendships. Students were also introduced to Rotary youth events such as RYLA and RYPEN, along with opportunities for short trips and excursions in their host country. The session generated considerable enthusiasm, with almost every child expressing interest in participating in the Youth Exchange programme.
location: Chatrapati Shivaji Vidyalaya, Dharavi, Mumbai, Maharashtra
